verdict.rationale: The README documents separate install routes for Claude Code (`claude plugin install`), Codex (`codex plugin marketplace add` / `plugin add`) and Copilot (`copilot plugin marketplace add` / `install`). The aihero site says the skills work with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, and its installer lets you pick which agents to target. A hands-on probe confirmed the agent-targeted `npx skills add ... -a claude-code` path installs cleanly. Missing for 10: Cursor-specific install instructions (Cursor appears only in the compatibility list), and hands-on verification of installs into non-Claude harnesses such as Codex, Copilot or Cursor.
